features.name: Diversification Ratio
features.discovered_gap: Standard diversification metrics ignore the interplay between cross-sectional dispersion and pairwise correlations.
features.financial_interpretation: Higher values indicate assets are more dispersed in returns while being less correlated, enhancing risk-adjusted diversification.
preprocessing: Clip dispersion to [0.001, 0.05] to avoid division by near-zero
features.minimum_sample: At least 5 assets to compute pairwise correlations
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Replace zero/negative dispersion with 0.001; replace zero/negative correlation with 0.1
features.reconstruction_pseudocode:
def diversification_ratio(dispersion, correlation):
    dispersion_clipped = clip(dispersion, 0.001, 0.05)
    correlation_clipped = clip(correlation, 0.1, 0.7)
    return dispersion_clipped / correlation_clipped
features.leakage_argument: Uses only historical cross-sectional statistics, no future returns or algorithmic feedback.

features.name: Liquidity-Volatility Product
features.discovered_gap: Standard volatility metrics ignore co-movement between price and volume dynamics.
features.financial_interpretation: Captures systemic liquidity risk where high price volatility coincides with erratic trading volume.
preprocessing: Normalize volatility metrics to [0,1] using min-max scaling within instance
features.minimum_sample: At least 3 observations per asset for volume volatility estimation
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Replace missing values with median of non-missing values
features.reconstruction_pseudocode:
def liquidity_volatility_product(price_vol, volume_vol):
    price_vol_norm = (price_vol - 0.01)/(0.035-0.01)
    volume_vol_norm = (volume_vol - 0.25)/(0.55-0.25)
    return price_vol_norm * volume_vol_norm
features.leakage_argument: Uses only contemporaneous price and volume statistics, no forward-looking signals.

features.name: Systemic Risk Indicator
features.discovered_gap: Standard negative return metrics ignore the spatial distribution of losses across assets.
features.financial_interpretation: High values indicate widespread negative returns occurring simultaneously across uncorrelated assets.
preprocessing: Normalize dispersion to [0,1] using min-max scaling
features.minimum_sample: At least 10 assets to compute dispersion
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Replace missing dispersion with median of 0.017
features.leakage_argument: Constructed entirely from contemporaneous cross-sectional statistics.

features.name: Asset-Count Adjusted Diversification
features.discovered_gap: Standard diversification metrics ignore the absolute number of assets in relation to correlation structure.
features.financial_interpretation: Measures effective diversification by comparing actual assets to the number needed to achieve observed correlation levels.
features.leakage_argument: Uses only asset count and contemporaneous correlation statistics.

features.name: Skewness Proxy
features.discovered_gap: Standard return metrics ignore the asymmetry between positive/negative returns in cross-section.
features.financial_interpretation: Captures hidden skewness where median returns are positive but most assets have negative returns.
features.leakage_argument: Constructed entirely from contemporaneous return statistics.

features.name: Data Quality Adjusted Volatility
features.discovered_gap: Standard volatility metrics ignore data completeness in multi-asset portfolios.
features.financial_interpretation: Adjusts volatility estimates downward when data completeness is low, reflecting potential measurement error.
features.minimum_sample: At least 80% non-missing observations per asset
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Replace missing values with median of 0.04
features.leakage_argument: Uses only contemporaneous volatility and data completeness metrics.

features.name: Return Dispersion-Volatility Ratio
features.discovered_gap: Standard dispersion metrics ignore relative scale of volatility.
features.financial_interpretation: Measures how dispersed returns are relative to the volatility of individual assets.
preprocessing: Normalize dispersion to [0,1] using min-max scaling
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Replace zero volatility with median of 0.02
features.leakage_argument: Uses only contemporaneous cross-sectional and individual volatility statistics.

features.name: Negative Return Concentration
features.discovered_gap: Standard negative return metrics ignore portfolio-wide concentration patterns.
features.financial_interpretation: Measures whether negative returns are concentrated or dispersed across assets.
features.leakage_argument: Uses only contemporaneous return statistics and asset count.

features.name: Volume Volatility-Return Volatility Ratio
features.discovered_gap: Standard volatility metrics ignore relative importance of volume vs price volatility.
features.financial_interpretation: High values indicate volume is more volatile than returns, potentially signaling liquidity issues.
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Replace zero values with median of non-missing values
features.reconstruction_pseudocode:
def volume_volatility_ratio(volume_vol, price_vol):
    volume_vol_norm = (volume_vol - 0.25)/(0.55-0.25)
    price_vol_norm = (price_vol - 0.01)/(0.035-0.01)
    return volume_vol_norm / price_vol_norm
features.leakage_argument: Uses only contemporaneous volume and price volatility statistics.

features.name: Cross-Sectional Skewness
features.discovered_gap: Standard skewness metrics ignore the asymmetry in return distributions across assets.
features.financial_interpretation: Measures whether positive returns are concentrated in a few assets vs widespread negative returns.
features.leakage_argument: Constructed entirely from contemporaneous return statistics and asset count.
